desc:
Two layers of storage with ample room for handguns, magazines and other accessories. High-density interlocking foam on one level; pre-perforated pluck foam on second level for easy customization. Contoured recessed latches. Strong, rigid ribbed construction.
Padlock tabs for added security. DIMENSIONS: L=17.1in. x W=14.86in. x H=5.57in. COLOR: Black.
